proposal.reason: Primary change is in network transport/proxy behavior: per-communicator NET/CollNet backend selection and lifecycle, NET plugin/request-limit updates, proxy progress batching, and proxy SHM pool-handle management. Add communicator because communicator config/lifecycle now owns netName/backend pointers and enforces parent-child shared-resource backend consistency. Add device-topology because intra-node NET-vs-P2P/SHM path-speed decisions (PATH_NET, net-affinity-aware checks) change topology path classification used for transport choice.
